classification.classification_note: MemorySanitizer reports the top project frame at the `flac__analyze_frame(...)` call in `write_callback`, but the poisoned scalar is stack local `dpos`, left unwritten after an unchecked `FLAC__stream_decoder_get_decode_position()` failure in Ogg mode.

bug_description.original: OSS-Fuzz issue 42535009 (flac): Use-of-uninitialized-value found by fuzz target fuzzer_tool_flac [msan]. https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/42535009
bug_description.original_source: sample_info.json issue_description / default_crash_trace.txt / sanitizer_trace.txt / reproduction_report.json / patch.diff / staged vulnerable source snapshot
bug_description.normalized: Stage 01's authoritative evidence is the saved default MemorySanitizer trace from the vulnerable image; the later local rebuild lost MSan fidelity. The reproduced source snapshot is staged checkout `49ab34dfefec4e964e7e32164be6c6acee0c51ab`, an ancestor of both metadata commits, and the anchors below use that exact line map. The 1209-byte witness is a combined argv+file input for `fuzzer_tool_flac`: its argv prefix contains `--ogg`, `--sk`, `1`, and `-Fa`, so `parse_options()` forces Ogg decoding, sample skip 1, and analysis mode before the remaining 864 bytes are written to a temp file. `DecoderSession_process()` therefore seeks to absolute sample 1, and `FLAC__stream_decoder_seek_absolute()` takes the Ogg arm `seek_to_absolute_sample_ogg_`, which reaches `write_callback` through `write_audio_frame_to_client_`. Inside `write_callback`, analysis mode allocates local `FLAC__uint64 dpos;` and calls `FLAC__stream_decoder_get_decode_position(decoder, &dpos)` without checking the boolean result. In the same staged libFLAC snapshot, `FLAC__stream_decoder_get_decode_position()` immediately returns false whenever `decoder->private_->is_ogg` is true, so it does not write through `&dpos`. Vulnerable code nevertheless computes `frame_bytes = dpos - decoder_session->decode_position`, copies `dpos` back into `decoder_session->decode_position`, and passes both poisoned values to `flac__analyze_frame()`. MemorySanitizer reports `use-of-uninitialized-value` at `src/flac/decode.c:1283` and names stack local `dpos` in `write_callback` as the origin. The staged patch resolves this obligation by threading `decode_position_valid`, checking both decode-position calls, and printing `?` instead of using unavailable offsets in analysis mode.

source.description: First project-side statement that consumes the witness-controlled argv and materializes the Ogg-mode dispatch key later checked by `FLAC__stream_decoder_get_decode_position()`.
source.value_from: The staged `poc` is 1209 bytes with SHA-256 `bdc8671256c52848aba6928219ac9faab9ab23e1f31bdfe6437cbf330c19a6c2`. `tool_flac` interprets byte 0 (`0xba`) as `maxarg=58, use_stdin=false`, extracts a NUL-delimited argv pool from bytes 1..344, and that pool includes exact strings `--ogg`, `--sk`, `1`, and `-Fa` before the remaining 864 bytes are written to the temporary decode file.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

tainted_value_origin.description: MemorySanitizer's origin stack names allocation of local `dpos` in `write_callback`. This stack slot later stays unwritten because `FLAC__stream_decoder_get_decode_position()` returns false in Ogg mode.

sink.description: MemorySanitizer crash site. This call consumes the poisoned `frame_bytes` and `decoder_session->decode_position` values derived from uninitialized local `dpos`.
sink.note: The authoritative saved MSan trace reports `use-of-uninitialized-value` at this exact line in `write_callback` and says the poisoned value was created by stack allocation of `dpos` at line 1235.

root_cause.description: Root cause. The boolean return from `FLAC__stream_decoder_get_decode_position()` is ignored, so the caller assumes `dpos` was initialized even though the same library returns false for Ogg decoders without writing through `&dpos`.
root_cause.note: The staged patch wraps this statement in `if(!FLAC__stream_decoder_get_decode_position(..., &dpos)) decoder_session->decode_position_valid = false;` and guards the surrounding analysis-mode logic on that validity bit.

parser_admitted.code: init_status = FLAC__stream_decoder_init_ogg_file(decoder_session->decoder, strcmp(infilename, "-")? infilename : 0, write_callback, metadata_callback, error_callback, /*client_data=*/decoder_session);
parser_admitted.description: Because the witness set `--ogg`, decoder initialization routes the temp file into the Ogg FLAC parser path instead of raw FLAC decoding.

seek_requested.description: The parsed skip specification equals 1, so the witnessed run actively seeks to sample 1 before normal end-of-stream decoding. This is why the saved stack contains `FLAC__stream_decoder_seek_absolute` and `seek_to_absolute_sample_ogg_`.

evidence_limitations: The authoritative runtime evidence is `default_crash_trace.txt` / `sanitizer_trace.txt` from the staged vulnerable image run. The local ARVO workspace rebuild reported missing MSan-instrumented libraries and only reproduced an MSan shadow-memory setup failure, not the issue stack.

The staged checkout is ancestor commit `49ab34dfefec4e964e7e32164be6c6acee0c51ab`, not metadata vulnerable commit `9977773a6027d96a223d2cac12428cdb88639798`; however it is still vulnerable, the staged patch edits the same logic there, and all line anchors below match the reproduced snapshot.
Stage 02 does not execute fixed runtime validation. `patch_resolves` below is source-grounded from the staged diff rather than from Stage 04 differential execution.

fine_trace.note: Non-scored harness step. The 1209-byte witness encodes a NUL-delimited argv pool and a file payload; the extracted argv includes `--ogg`, `--sk`, `1`, and `-Fa`, and the remaining 864 bytes are written to a temp file that is appended as the decode input path.
Source. `parse_option()` consumes the witness's `--ogg` argv entry and sets the Ogg-mode dispatch flag that later makes `FLAC__stream_decoder_get_decode_position()` reject decode-position queries.

The witness also supplies `--sk` followed by `1`. The local `share__getopt_long()` implementation accepts unambiguous long-option prefixes, so this token reaches the `skip` case and preserves the sample skip as string `"1"`.
The extracted short-option cluster `-Fa` eventually reaches case `'a'`, forcing decode mode and analysis mode. This is the only state that enters the `dpos` block in `write_callback`.
Parsing the carried string `"1"` yields `value_is_samples = true`, `is_relative = false`, and `spec->value.samples = 1`.

Because step 2 forced Ogg mode, `decode_file()` initializes the stream decoder through `FLAC__stream_decoder_init_ogg_file()`, and init stores `decoder->private_->is_ogg = true`. This is the exact state checked later by `FLAC__stream_decoder_get_decode_position()`.
After metadata decoding, the parsed skip remains positive. This branch sees `value.samples == 1` and calls `FLAC__stream_decoder_seek_absolute(d->decoder, 1)` before normal end-of-stream decoding.
With step 6's Ogg flag set and step 7's `sample == 1`, seek dispatches into `seek_to_absolute_sample_ogg_`. This exact Ogg arm appears in the saved MSan stack.

During Ogg seeking, the decoded frame covering target sample 1 takes this target-frame branch and invokes `write_callback` instead of returning `CONTINUE`. The saved stack reaches `write_callback` through this function.

Because step 4 enabled analysis mode and step 9 called into `write_callback`, execution enters the analysis block and allocates local `dpos`. MemorySanitizer names this stack slot as the uninitialized origin.
Root cause. The boolean result is ignored, so the caller assumes `dpos` was initialized even though the same library explicitly refuses decode-position queries on Ogg decoders.
Because step 6 set `decoder->private_->is_ogg = true`, this callee returns `false` before any `*position` store or tell callback. The `dpos` slot from step 10 therefore remains unwritten.
Unsafe propagation. The subtraction consumes still-uninitialized `dpos` and poisons `frame_bytes`.
Second propagation. The same unwritten `dpos` also overwrites `decoder_session->decode_position`, poisoning the later frame-offset argument.

Sink. This call consumes both poisoned scalars from steps 13-14 as the analysis-frame offset and size. The saved default MSan trace reports `use-of-uninitialized-value` at this exact line and attributes the origin to `dpos` at line 1235.

allocation_context.note: The saved MSan origin says `Uninitialized value was created by an allocation of 'dpos' in the stack frame` at this line.

cross_validation.root_cause_matches_allocation_context: The MSan origin is the `dpos` stack slot allocated at `write_callback:1235`; the root-cause step is the immediately following unchecked call that fails to initialize that same slot in Ogg mode.

poc.trigger: The staged 1209-byte witness reproduces the saved default `MemorySanitizer: use-of-uninitialized-value` in `write_callback` at `src/flac/decode.c:1283` when `fuzzer_tool_flac` processes it. The later local rebuild lost MSan fidelity, so `default_crash_trace.txt` / `sanitizer_trace.txt` remain the runtime source of truth.

format.name: fuzzer_tool_flac combined argv+file witness
format.contract: Exactly the staged 1209-byte `poc` with SHA-256 `bdc8671256c52848aba6928219ac9faab9ab23e1f31bdfe6437cbf330c19a6c2`. Byte 0 is `0xba` (`maxarg=58`, `use_stdin=false`); bytes 1..344 are the exact NUL-delimited argv pool containing `--ogg`, `--sk`, `1`, and `-Fa`; bytes 345..1208 are the exact temp-file payload written to the decoder. No broader argv or container family is claimed.
